thread:
maya: Hey team — noticed ~120 invoices yesterday where the customer-level promo/discount didn't show up in NetSuite, totals are higher than Stripe. cc @kevin
kevin: Ugh. Any pattern? specific plans, promo codes, or is it random?
lisa: I pulled a quick sample: all affected charges are from the new pricing-experiment cohort (promo slug: Q1-BETA-10). Stripe invoice payload has discount object, but NetSuite line items are missing the negative line.
kevin: Ok can someone check the webhook processor logs? Might be a filter that dropped discount when constructing NS lines. @sam_engineer?
sam_engineer: digging in. quick note: webhook-processor has a small filter we added last month to normalize invoice.lines -> we were skipping lines with type=="promotion" because we thought NetSuite handles promos as invoice-level adjustments. Looks like the payload for experiments is promotion on line items, not invoice-level.
sam_engineer: log snippet: ```ERROR webhook-processor skipping promo-line id=pm_1Kx42 reason=type_filter match
payload.invoice.lines.data[2] = {"id":"li_ABC", "type":"promotion", "amount": -1000, "promotion_code": "Q1-BETA-10"}```
maya: So the processor intentionally removed these lines. That explains missing negative lines in NS. How many invoices affected?
lisa: Counted 124 in the window 2026-03-20 00:00 to 2026-03-20 23:59 UTC. 3 customers already disputed, 2 requested refunds. Net delta ~ -$9,500 USD.
kevin: We need a quick rollback/hotfix to include promotion lines and a backfill job to push negative lines into NetSuite. Also need to flag customers who were billed incorrectly for manual credits.
sam_engineer: Hotfix: change filter to only skip promotions marked as "internal_promo" (we weren't using that) and ensure promotion lines are converted to NS credit lines. I'll raise a deployment PR and a short patch to webhook-processor: ```- if line.type == 'promotion': continue
+ if line.type == 'promotion' && line.metadata.internal_promo == 'true': continue
```
kevin: sounds good. How long to deploy?
sam_engineer: 30-45 mins for code + canary + full rollout. But we also have DLQ entries for processed events that didn't push to NS — I'll requeue them once patch is live.
reconciliation-bot: night_reconciler detected discrepancy for 124 invoices, tag=BILLING_PROMO_MISSING, job_id=nr-20260320-41
lisa: For customer-facing next steps: I suggest we 1) create credit memos in NetSuite for the 124 invoices (auto-generated by backfill job), 2) send apology + credit note to customers (finance template), 3) mark the pricing experiment cohort so support has context.
maya: Agree. Kevin, can you approve auto-crediting? We should avoid manual journals if possible.
kevin: Approve auto-credit workflow for these cases, since amounts are small and it's a systematic bug. Make sure we log journal IDs and include audit note: "auto credit - promo line missing due to webhook filter".
sam_engineer: I'll run backfill after deploy: `webhook-processor replay --from 2026-03-20T00:00Z --to 2026-03-20T23:59Z --include-promotions` then `ns-sync apply --dry-run` first, then actual. Expect ~45 min for requeue + processing.
lisa: I'll prepare the credit memo email template and a list of affected customers. Will include support playbook.
maya: Please also add a postmortem entry so we can update tests: webhook-processor unit test should cover promotion lines mapping to NetSuite credit lines.
kevin: +1 on tests. Also file a small alert in alerts-billing if promo lines > 0 and not present in NS mapping in nightly checks.
kevin: tagging @sam_engineer for the deploy. Sam, post here when it's live and when requeue done.
sam_engineer: deploying patch to staging now. Will post canary status.
kevin: thx. :thumbsup:
